signatures.description: Implement a crash-safe write-ahead log with group commit: concurrent writers batch fsyncs, every record carries a CRC, and the log must survive process kill at any byte offset (torn tail writes). On recovery, scan records, detect the first corrupt/short frame, truncate the log to the last fully durable transaction boundary, and report which committed transactions survive. Must handle duplicate LSNs from a replayed partially-applied tx and prove recovery is idempotent across repeated crash loops.
